value.rationale: Cross-degree leakage directly measures spurious mixing between quadrupole and octupole spherical harmonics under incomplete polar observations. The finding provides a sharp all-dimensional singular spectrum, two nontrivial symmetry-switch apertures with exact degeneracies, a dimension-dependent small-angle scale, and sharp thin-cap ill-conditioning. These motivated consequences are not a routine reparameterization of a known full-band Slepian eigenvalue.
